name: codexrunway-reset-tracker
title: CodexRunway Reset Tracker
description: Track CodexRunway usage reset schedule and completion status right from the menu bar
author: evilmouth

commands.name: menubar
commands.title: Reset Status (Menu Bar)
commands.subtitle: CodexRunway
commands.description: Shows the latest reset status in the menu bar, auto-refreshing every 10 minutes

preferences.name: iconOnly
preferences.title: Menu Bar Display
preferences.label: Show icon only
preferences.description: Keep the status in the tooltip and expanded menu.

preferences.name: notifyResets
preferences.title: Completion Notifications
preferences.label: Notify when a new reset is confirmed
preferences.description: Uses macOS notifications. The first background check establishes a baseline; subsequent checks notify only new completions matching your plan. Requires background refresh.

commands.name: latest
commands.title: View Latest Reset
commands.subtitle: CodexRunway
commands.description: Shows full details of the latest reset record

commands.name: history
commands.title: Browse Reset History
commands.subtitle: CodexRunway
commands.description: Browse paginated reset records, filterable by kind

scripts.test: TZ=UTC node tests/api.cjs && TZ=UTC node tests/requests.cjs && TZ=UTC node tests/notifications.cjs

preferences.name: plan
preferences.title: Subscription Plan
preferences.description: Show resets explicitly covering this plan, including records marked for all plans. Unspecified scope is only shown with All Plans.
